tools.name: search_destinations
tools.description: Find the countries and regions Wigoo sells travel eSIMs for, with the starting price and a buy link. Search by country or region name in English, or by ISO country code. Without a query it returns the popular destinations.

tools.name: get_destination
tools.description: What a destination offers: networks, data sizes, validity options, whether unlimited day passes and top ups exist, the starting price, and what the traveler needs to know.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: The plans on sale for a destination, with data, validity, networks and price in the requested currency. Unlimited plans give a daily amount at full speed, then a reduced speed.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: The price of one plan in the requested currency, and the link where the traveler buys it on getwigoo.com. This tool does not place an order: the purchase happens on the site.
